## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Ran the smallest relevant tests.
- [ ] Ran `npm run build`.
- [ ] Ran `npm audit`.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, private transcripts, databases, logs, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Privacy and stored-data effects are documented.
- [ ] Security and process-control effects are documented.
- [ ] Windows and macOS behavior was considered.
- [ ] Related documentation was updated.
